entry.title: How to Expose Parameterized CDS Views as an OData Service in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud RAP for Fiori
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

We are developing a custom Raw Material Report in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud using the RAP and SAP Fiori Elements App.

As per the business requirements, the report contains 10 fields, including Raw Material and various quantity fields such as Opening Quantity, Issued Quantity, and Purchase Order Quantity. The quantity fields must be calculated based on the user selected date range, with the relevant quantities aggregated for each material within the specified period.

To achieve this requirement, I have implemented parameterized CDS views to fetch and aggregate the data based on the selected date range. However, while attempting to expose these CDS views through the Service Definition and Service Binding, I encountered an issue because the parameterized CDS views are not directly supported for OData service exposure in the current approach.

As a result, I am unable to create OData service, which is blocking the deployment of the Fiori Elements application.

Could you please suggest an alternative solution to handle the date  dependent calculations and expose the CDS view data through an OData service in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud?

Please find attached a screenshot of the parameterized CDS view for your reference.

Thank you

entry.title: Query regarding Retrofit-SPS Upgarde
entry.content:
We are currently in progress with SPS upgrade (ECC EHP 8, SP25).

As part of it, we need to retrofit few changes (Programs, Smartforms etc.) in the upgraded Development system which were earlier carried out in non-upgraded Quality & Pre-Production systems.

entry.title: Validation in EDI processing in SAP GUI
entry.content: We have a requirement to validate the price received through EDI while creating the Sales Order in SAP. The expected process should be as follows: When a Sales Order is received through EDI, the price provided in the EDI message should be checked against the price maintained in the Customer Condition Record. . entry.title: SAP TM 9.6 SP11 – Standard API/BAPI/FM to Create Rate Values and New Validity Periods Programmatical
entry.content:
Hello SAP Community,

I am working on a custom ABAP report in SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM 9.6 SP11) to automate the upload of linehaul rates from an Excel file provided by carriers.

The requirement is to update existing rate tables by creating new validity periods and adding the corresponding rate values.

The expected functionality includes:

  1. Identifying the existing active validity period for a rate table.

  2. Updating the existing Valid To date to one day before the new Valid From date.

  3. Creating a new validity period with the required Valid From and Valid To dates.

  4. Adding the required calculation rule and rate values.

  5. Saving and releasing the rate table.

  6. Implementing error handling and delta-run functionality to reprocess failed records.

I have investigated the standard report /SCMTMS/TCC_RATES_EXCEL_NEW and the function module /SCMTMS/WRITE_RATE_RFC, but I have not yet identified a suitable, supported API for implementing the complete requirement directly from my custom report.

I would appreciate guidance on the following questions:

  • Is there a standard BAPI, function module, or class available in SAP TM 9.6 SP11 to create or update rate values and validity periods programmatically?

  • Can the /scmtms/tc_rates BOPF business object be used for this requirement? If so, which nodes, actions, or APIs should be investigated?

  • Is there a supported way to reuse the standard Excel upload processing without manually reproducing its logic?

  • Can /SCMTMS/RATE_MASS_UPDATE handle this scenario, or is it intended for a different use case?

  • Are there any relevant SAP Notes, documentation, or working implementation examples available?

My preference is to use standard SAP functionality wherever possible rather than directly updating database tables or implementing unsupported persistence logic.

Any technical guidance or examples specific to SAP TM 9.6 would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you.

entry.title: Exit to Create a Debit/Credit Memo in VA01 with reference to a BIlling Document
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

When creating a debit/credit memo in transaction VA01 with reference to a billing document, the system automatically copies the items, materials, and properties, and correctly updates the document flow (showing the preceding billing document, goods receipt, etc.) when viewed in VA03.

I am currently facing a requirement where I need to create a debit/credit memo via VA01 **without** using the standard reference to a billing document (i.e., created in "normal" mode), but I still need the document flow to link back to that specific billing document.

To achieve this, I attempted to use the user exit `USEREXIT_SAVE_DOCUMENT_PREPARE` by populating the following internal structures:

- **XVBFA (Document Flow):**
- VBELV: Billing document number (preceding document)
- POSNV: Billing document item
- VBELN: Left empty (assigned by the system upon saving)
- POSNN: Debit/credit memo item
- VBTYP_V: 'M' (Invoice)
- VBTYP_N: 'H' (Returns / Credit Memo depending on config)
- RFMNG, MEINS, RFWRT, WAERS, ERDAT, ERZET
- UPDKZ: 'I' (Insert)

- **XVBAK (Header):**
- VGBEL: Reference billing document number
- VGTYP: 'M' (Invoice)

- **XVBAP (Items):**
- VGPOS: Reference billing document item
- UPDKZ: 'U' (Update)

But when I check the document flow in VA03 after saving, the reference to the billing document does not appear; I only see the debit/credit memo itself.

Has anyone faced a similar requirement? Is there an alternative user exit, BAdI, or specific field combination required to force the document flow and reference fields to persist when creating a document without direct reference?

entry.title: Reading classic dynpro flow logic remotely over ADT (HTTP): is there an endpoint, or only RFC?
entry.content:
Hi all,

This morning I was answering a question about the partner tab in VA01 (function group V09C, screen 1000), and I wanted to read the flow logic of that screen to see which modules run inside LOOP WITH CONTROL. I read most standard code through ADT, and for classes, function modules and includes everything is there. For classic screens I got stuck.

What I checked, on S/4HANA 2023 (SAP_BASIS 758) and S/4HANA 2025 (816):

  • The ADT discovery document (/sap/bc/adt/discovery) has no collection for classic screens in either release. The only "screen" in it is the value help for logical database selection screens.
  • The where-used list does know the screen: a where-used on PBO module IS_ENHANCEMENT_01 returns screen 1000 as object type FUGR/PS, with a /sap/bc/adt/vit/wb/... URI. I haven't found a source endpoint behind it.
  • Over RFC there is a way: SVRS_GET_VERSION_DYNP_40 is RFC-enabled and has a D022S_TAB table parameter, which is the flow logic. IMPORT_DYNPRO is RFC-enabled too, but it returns only the header (D020S) and the fields (D021S). RPY_DYNPRO_READ has everything, but it is not RFC-enabled.

So my question: is there an ADT (HTTP) endpoint that returns the flow logic of a classic screen, read-only, that I'm missing? Or is the honest answer "SAP GUI or RFC"?

And if you work with ADT in VS Code or in Eclipse without SAP GUI, how do you look at PBO/PAI today?

In the V09C case I got around it from the other side: SAP's own IS-Oil enhancement implementation OIG_SAPLV09C_01 works on the current table control line, so that module has to run inside the loop. But I would like to see it, not deduce it.
